title: hl.yml
description: hl homelab config: the proxy, and the apps behind it. Reference: https://github.com/DeM-Conve/project__hl#hlyml

version.description: The hl.yml format. hl writes 1; a file without it is the format before versions and is upgraded the next time hl edits it.

proxy.description: The Traefik proxy every app is reached through.

bind.description: Address the proxy listens on. 127.0.0.1 = this machine only; 0.0.0.0 = reachable from your network.

port.description: Host port the proxy listens on.

routing.description: Default routing for apps that don't set their own. path: http://<domain>/<app>/ (the app must support a base path); host: http://<app>.<domain>.

domain.description: Path routing serves apps at <domain>/<app>/, host routing at <app>.<domain>.

network.description: Docker network the proxy shares with the apps.

subnet.description: Optional fixed subnet for that network, so apps can trust the proxy by address.

image.description: The Traefik image the proxy runs. hl is tested with the default; hl doctor warns about older ones.

project.description: Compose project the proxy runs as; set it to run a second homelab's proxy beside the first.

config.description: Your own Traefik static config file instead of the generated one, relative to the homelab folder.

dynamic.description: A Traefik dynamic config file (file provider) for routes that aren't hl apps, relative to the homelab folder.

access_log.description: Traefik's access log, on the proxy's output (hl proxy logs). Not with proxy.config.

log_level.description: Traefik's log level (default ERROR). Not with proxy.config.

env.description: Settings passed to every app's compose file, e.g. TZ. An app's own env wins.

apps.description: The apps, by name. Added with `hl add <folder>`.

projects.description: Folders whose subfolders with a compose file are apps, for hl init and hl sync: absolute, ~, or relative to the homelab folder.

ignore.description: Folder-name patterns (shell globs) hl sync never picks up, on top of the built-in ones. A folder with a .hlignore file is skipped too.

scan_depth.description: How deep below a projects folder to look for apps: 1 = direct subfolders, 2 also <group>/<app>. 0 or unset = the default.

path.description: The app's folder (with its own compose file): absolute, ~, or relative to the homelab folder.

compose.description: Compose files inside the app's folder. Default: the one docker compose would pick.

service.description: The service the proxy forwards to. hl add picks it.

port.description: That service's port inside its container.

routing.description: path, host or none (not behind the proxy). Default: proxy.routing.

prefix.description: Path routing: the URL prefix, without a trailing slash. Default: /<app>.

host.description: Host routing: the host name. Default: <app>.<domain>.

env_files.description: Extra env files, relative to the homelab folder, read after the app's own .env.

env.description: Settings passed to the app's compose file. Values can use ${HL_URL}, ${HL_PREFIX}, ${HL_HOST}, ${HL_DATA} and ${HL_APP}.
